items.title: Thailand SEC says several companies eye crypto ETFs, none has applied
items.summary: Thailand's SEC says several asset managers have sought consultations on spot crypto ETFs, but it cannot confirm whether the first funds will launch in 2026.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF buyers are trend followers, not setters, DWF Labs says
items.summary: DWF Labs research finds that Bitcoin ETF flows follow past BTC price movements rather than predict future returns, with investors buying rallies and selling dips.
